name: cmg-educational-animation
description: Banco de pruebas de vídeos educativos de Codemageddon (fuera del juego).

scripts.remotion: pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion sync-assets && pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion studio
scripts.render:remotion: pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion sync-assets && pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion render && node tools/render-manifest.mjs renders/remotion/await-pilot.mp4 AwaitPilot
scripts.render:remotion:en: pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion sync-assets && pnpm --filter cmg-anim-remotion render:en && node tools/render-manifest.mjs renders/remotion/await-pilot-en.mp4 AwaitPilotEn
